extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism claims from source XML/PDF sections, figure captions, and methods.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin II damages Candida albicans morphology and cell-surface integrity at MIC/MFC exposure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane/cell-surface damage is supported; exact molecular membrane target is not identified.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin II increases intracellular ROS signal in Candida albicans under MIC/MFC treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS increase is source-supported; the primary molecular source of ROS is not resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin II binds or disrupts Candida albicans genomic DNA and RNA in mobility-shift assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Octominin II with Candida albicans nucleic acids
mechanism_claims.limitations: Gel mobility/degradation evidence supports nucleic-acid interaction but not a precise intracellular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin II suppresses tested Candida albicans virulence-associated transcripts at 0.5 MIC and MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Candida albicans CDR1, TUP1, AGE3, GSC1, SAP2, SAP9 after Octominin II treatment
mechanism_claims.limitations: Transcript suppression is downstream context and should not be promoted to direct target binding.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Octominin II inhibits biofilm formation and helps eradicate mature Candida albicans biofilms in local assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional biofilm phenotype is supported; exact anti-biofilm molecular mechanism remains unresolved.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary assays support membrane damage, ROS, nucleic-acid interaction, transcript suppression, and biofilm phenotypes but do not identify one precise direct molecular target.
